description.p: LocalSend lets you share files with nearby devices over your local network. No account, no cloud and no internet connection is required.
This native GNOME app is built with GTK 4 and libadwaita and speaks the LocalSend protocol, so it works with the LocalSend apps on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux.

ul.li: Automatic device discovery on the local network
Send files and folders by picking them or dropping them on the window
Optional PIN protection and encrypted transfers

description.p: Build the Flatpak bundle on a plain runner so releases are produced reliably.
Point the About dialog and app metadata at the project repository.
Show the file count and total size as soon as a transfer starts, instead of waiting for the first bytes to arrive.

Send several files at once and serve uploads on a multi-threaded runtime, so transfers of many files finish much faster. Progress, the selected-file count and the completion summary stay accurate while uploads overlap.
Stop the history view from interrupting transfers with a refresh notice, and build releases on Node 24.
Publish automated stable and nightly builds, document installation, and clarify licensing and attribution.
Keep history entries visible after removing an item and make expanding large transfers faster.
Fix a crash when refreshing the history after deleting an item and free history rows that were kept in memory.
Reuse history rows during refresh to avoid redrawing the entire list and make expanding transfers smoother.
Keep history transfers expanded across refreshes and load their contents more smoothly.
Fix history dialog refresh duplicating entries instead of replacing them.
Refresh the history dialog after item removal once the confirmation alert closes.
Always refresh the history view after removing or deleting an item.
Fix removing history items from multi-file transfers and refresh the history view after deletion.
Open history faster by loading file rows on demand and cap it at 100 transfers.
Keep receive progress monotonic when one file completes while others are still uploading.
Skip files the receiver already has, enforce the upload source address, and preserve file timestamps.
Leave the page of a device that disappears during a transfer and restore the transfer view instead.
Send SHA-256 checksums with outgoing files and messages so peers can verify what they receive.
Allow switching devices during a transfer and mark each file as received or waiting in the transfer file list.
Match the transfer progress ring to the header menu icon size and shrink the file list dialog slightly.
Make multi-file receive progress monotonic when peers upload several files at once.
Fix multi-file progress accounting and the header ring, style the file list as a single rounded card, narrow the dialog, and add a Start in Background setting.

Add a header transfer-progress indicator, keep progress visible when switching devices, rebuild the file list dialog with native styling and middle-ellipsized names, and detect sender cancellation on the decision screen.
Fix the colors and corners of the receive file list dialog.
Show the file-count as a pill, widen the receive file list dialog, and notify the sender when a transfer is canceled.
Show the list of filenames for multi-file transfers when tapping the file count during receive.
Show the received-message dialog when the window is visible, including with Quick Save enabled.
Fix the empty History page losing its status icon and message.
Use native GTK and GLib APIs for clipboard, URL escaping, timestamps and hex output, and clean up the codebase.
Clean up compiler warnings and unused code.
Allow removing individual files from expanded multi-file queue groups.
Expand multi-file queue groups to show all files when clicked.
Ellipsize long file names in the queue so the layout no longer expands.
Show file-type icons for items in the send queue.
Release cached dialog state and trim memory when dialogs close or the window is hidden to the tray.
Reduce background memory usage by trimming freed heap memory while hidden and using a lighter server runtime.
Reverted recent memory-optimization experiments that increased RAM usage in practice.

Improved history and settings: attached history dialog, live updates after changes, clearer empty state, click-to-open items, cache controls in Settings, and stable multi-file receive progress labels.
Added a transfer history with a 128 MB cache, quick access to cached files and messages, and per-item copy, open, and delete actions.
Queue files and messages before choosing a device, redesigned home page, in-window confirmation for incoming transfers, and calmer notifications.
Automatic receiving, clipboard text delivery, tray icon and notification fixes.
Version bump for testing.
Improved clipboard handling with wl-copy, added desktop notifications, and background transfer updates.
Initial release.
